stories.title: Morning update
stories.summary: Morning update Good morning Middle East Eye readers, Here is a recap of the latest developments:  Turkey has denied "frivolous" Israeli allegations that it posed a threat by preparing to send troops to a base in Syria, and said that accusations stem from Benjamin Netanyahu's intention to pursue his "expansionist and destabilizing policies" in the region ahead of elections. An explosion to a major pipeline in north eastern Syria has put a stop to gas flow from the Al-Jabsah gas plant, the Syrian Petroleum Company (SPC) said. This has resulted in the disruption of supplies to a number of power generation turbines. No workers in the area were reported injured in the blast.&n
